{"id": "mm5337a2",
 "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "approximately 75,766 AADs and 2.3 million YPLLs"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 75,766 deaths, 34,833 (46%) resulted from chronic conditions, and 40,933 (54%) resulted from acute conditions."}]},
 "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the estimated 2,279,322 YPLLs, 788,005 (35%) resulted from chronic conditions"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 54,847 (72%) of all AADs involved males, and 4,554 (6%) involved persons aged <21 years."}]}],
 "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "approximately 75,766 AADs and 2.3 million YPLLs"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 75,766 deaths, 34,833 (46%) resulted from chronic conditions, and 40,933 (54%) resulted from acute conditions."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The 2.3 million YPLLs for excessive drinking is approximately half of the total YPLLs that were caused by smoking in 1999"}]}],
 "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Alcohol-Related Disease Impact (ARDI)* software was used to estimate the number of AADs and YPLLs."}]}],
 "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "ARDI estimates AADs by multiplying the number of deaths from a particular alcohol-related condition by its alcohol-attributable fraction (AAF)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "are then calculated by multiplying age- and sex-specific AAD estimates by the corresponding estimate of life expectancy."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the system calculates AAFs by using relative risk estimates from meta-analyses"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "AAFs for motor-vehicle--traffic deaths are obtained from the Fatality Analysis Reporting System"}],
 "confidence": "medium",
 "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
